map.⚠ 目标税后所得、扣除额须为 ≥0 的数值，税率须在 0–100%（不含 100: ⚠ Target after-tax income and deductions must be numbers ≥ 0; the tax rate must be between 0 and 100% (excluding 100%).
map.假设：扣除额为税前扣除、单一比例税率、无其他减免与附加税；分段税制需按对应税率表: Assumption: deductions are pre-tax, a single flat rate applies, and there are no other reliefs or surtaxes. Progressive systems require the relevant rate table; this result is not tax advice.
map.若税后目标 t ≤ 扣除额 d：税前总收入 = t，应税所得与税额均为 0。若: Required gross income = (target after-tax income t − deductions d × rate r) ÷ (1 − r); taxable income = gross − d; tax = taxable × r. Validation: t and d ≥ 0, rate 0–100% (excluding 100%), otherwise blocked. The deduction is pre-tax, so it must be subtracted after grossing up, not added to the target.
map.为什么目标低于扣除额时税额为 0？: Why is the tax zero when the target is below the deduction?
map.税后所得 = 税前收入 − max(税前收入 − 扣除额, 0)×r。目标 t: After-tax income = gross − max(gross − deduction, 0) × r. If target t ≤ deduction d, set gross = t and no tax is due; only when t > d do you back-solve gross = (t − d·r)/(1−r).
map.税前总收入 = (750000 − 0) / (1 − 0.25) = 1,00: Required gross income = (750000 - 0) / (1 - 0.25) = 1,000,000 CNY; tax = (1,000,000 - 0) x 0.25 = 250,000 CNY, after-tax exactly 750k.
map.若还可扣除 10 万（deduct=100000），税前总收入 = (75000: With an additional deduction of 100,000, gross income = (750000 - 100000 x 0.25) / 0.75 = 966,666.67 CNY; taxable income = 866,666.67 CNY; tax = 216,666.67 CNY; after-tax remains 750,000 CNY.
